item.title: Mithril Silver and Gold Delivers Impressive Grades From Channel Sampling at Copalquin Project
item.description: Mithril Silver and Gold (ASX: MTH) has reported channel sampling results of up to 38.2 grams per tonne gold and 4,520g/t silver over multiple targets at its Copalquin project in Mexico.

item.title: Minerals 260 Doubles Contained Gold Resource Estimate at Bullabulling Project in WA
item.description: Minerals 260 (ASX: MI6) has doubled the contained gold at its Bullabulling project in Western Australia to 4.5 million ounces, establishing it as one of the nation’s leading gold developments.

item.title: Sentinel Metals Uses Pre-Drilling Data to Advance Epithermal Targeting at Columbia Gold Project
item.description: Sentinel Metals (ASX: SNM) has completed a multi-disciplinary campaign of pre-drilling activities at its flagship Columbia gold project in the US, paving the way for the definition of new high-impact drill targets.

item.title: Why There Is a Ceasefire in the Bank Wars—For Now
item.description: The ceasefire between the banks in the war for deposits is still holding at this stage but it may not be long before we see it break out in earnest, after the revelation that Macquarie Bank now has more than $200 billion in retail and business deposits.

item.title: Barton Gold Reports Broad, High-Grade Assays from S1 Pit Area at Tunkillia Project
item.description: Barton Gold (ASX: BGD) (OTCQB: BGDFF) has confirmed that first assays from drilling at its Tunkillia project in South Australia support a higher-grade model for the project’s S1 ‘starter pit’ mineralisation.

item.title: Thick Gold Intercepts Signal Large-Scale Potential at Golden Gate for Resolution Minerals
item.description: Resolution Minerals (ASX: RML) has announced further strong results from its maiden drill program at the Golden Gate prospect, part of the Horse Heaven Project in Idaho, USA.

item.title: RooLife Group Exceeds $1m Sales of RLG Coffee Products in November to Growing Chinese Market
item.description: RooLife Group (ASX: RLG) has reported more than $1 million in sales of newly-launched RLG Coffee products including beans, beverages, packaged foods, and coffee machines to the Chinese market during November.

item.title: Gold Hydrogen Identifies Hydrogen-Helium Continuity Across Ramsay Gas Field
item.description: Gold Hydrogen (ASX: GHY) has identified several zones with elevated levels of natural hydrogen and helium at its Ramsay 3 well in SA, confirming continuity across approximately 2.3km and strengthening the geological model for a natural hydrogen-helium system.

item.title: Tennant Minerals Starts Expansion Drilling at Barkly Project’s Bluebird Copper-Gold Deposit
item.description: Tennant Minerals (ASX: TMS) has commenced a drilling campaign to test and expand a new gold zone at the Bluebird deposit within its Barkly project in the NT, where it has identified copper-gold mineralisation across a 500m strike at depths of more than 250m.

item.title: Altair Minerals Accelerates Exploration at South Oko Project in Guyana with New Trenching Program
item.description: Altair Minerals (ASX: ALR) is “aggressively accelerating the targets toward drilling” with a new trenching program across a combined length of approximately 3km at its South Oko prospect in Guyana.
